      Registration opens June 16

      New services are launching. Architectures are shifting. The decisions you make next matter. 

      AWS re:Invent is five days in Las Vegas: keynotes, sessions, hands-on labs, and direct access to the people closest to the technology and the decisions around it. 

      Whatever's stalling your next move — an architecture decision, a migration tradeoff, a build-or-buy question — this is where you work through it, with the right people in the room. 

      Add a calendar reminder for when registration opens here.  

      AWS re:Invent is where what’s next becomes real

      Join 60,000+ peers and experts from 20+ industries across 2,200+ sessions, labs, and learning opportunities, all built to help you turn your biggest questions into your biggest breakthroughs.

      Explore and understand

      New services launch on stage and you can go deep the same day with live demos and technical sessions. re:Invent puts you at the center of what's happening across cloud and AI, with the context to know what's changing, how cross-industry leaders are responding, and what it means for your business.

      Validate and decide

      Bring the decisions you're actually weighing. Compare approaches with AWS engineers, pressure-test your strategy in small groups of 10–25, and walk away with tested, vetted best practices ready to put into production. You'll hear not just what worked, but what didn't, from the people who design the services you rely on.

      Expand what’s possible

      Hands-on labs. Small group sessions. All built to draw on your experience and stretch it further. Your challenges shape the conversation, and the insights come from leaders who've faced similar problems, solved them, and bring perspectives you wouldn't find on your own.

      Connect and belong

      Find your people. The peers, experts, and industry leaders who share your challenges. Get honest insights, candid stories, and hard-won advice from people who have been where you stand. The conversations that happen between sessions are often just as impactful as the sessions themselves.

      Lock in your pass

      One pass. Full access to keynotes, sessions, hands-on labs, and the people building what's next. The only thing that changes is the price. Register by 11:59 PM PDT on August 25, 2026 and save $1,200. Bringing your team? Bulk discount tickets save you more. Whether you're coming to explore what's launching, validate a strategy, or upskill your team — it all starts here.

      General Event Information

      Open all

        AWS re:Invent is the largest annual gathering of the cloud and AI community. Five days in Las Vegas  including keynotes with major AWS launches, 2,200+ sessions  (workshops, labs, Chalk Talks, Builder Sessions, demos, and more), content for every skill level, from foundational to expert,  direct access to AWS architects and engineers, and an expo with AWS Partners  across virtually every industry. Here you’ll learn how cross-industry peers are building and solving problems like yours. Plus, community meetups, and co-working spaces mean you'll build relationships that last well beyond AWS re:Invent. It’s where what’s next becomes real.

        1. 2,200+ sessions in every format from workshops to demos, covering the full range of AWS services. You'll find honest, technical depth from AWS experts who help you understand how services work, where they fit your architecture, and how to put it into practice.
        2. Executive and strategic programming designed for leaders making platform, investment, and organizational decisions - with direct access to AWS leadership and peers navigating similar challenges. 
        3. Direct access to AWS Partners in the expo who can help you scale, implement, and integrate. Plus, Ask the Experts sessions where you sit down with AWS engineers on your specific challenges. 
        4. Real stories from customers doing the work. Past speakers have included leaders from Adobe, Anthropic, JPMorgan Chase, Sony, WRITER, and more — sharing what worked, what didn't, and where they're headed. 
        5. Community meetups, social events, and networking with peers and leaders across the cloud and AI community worldwide.

        AWS re:Invent is for anyone trying to move forward, whether that means solving a technical problem, making a platform decision, building new skills, or figuring out where cloud and AI fit into what's next for your organization. Content and experiences designed for every level.

        November 30 – December 4 in Las Vegas, NV. The conference takes place across multiple venues including Caesars Forum, Caesars Palace, Encore, MGM Grand, The Venetian, and Wynn.

        Registration opens on June 16, 2026. Subscribe for updates.

        The following services are available to everyone onsite, with no advanced request required:

        • Accessible seating
        • All-gender restrooms
        • Assistive listening devices
        • Lactation room
        • Live captioning
        • Reflection room
        • Translations for keynotes

        These additional services can be requested in advance:

        • ASL (American Sign Language)
        • Halal and Kosher meals
        • Mobility device rental
        • Sighted guide

        To request any of these services or inquire about a service you don’t see listed, including neurodivergent and sensory need requests, contact customer support at awsreinvent-support@amazon.com. To properly coordinate services, all requests must be received by Nov. 13th. Requests for services received after this date cannot be guaranteed.

        We firmly believe in the value and importance of an environment where all AWS community members feel welcome and safe. This Code of Conduct explains the behavior we expect from AWS community members interacting at AWS events and programs, and across AWS blogs, online forums, and social media platforms. All attendees must comply with the AWS Code of Conduct.
